epic.title: Initiative: Eval-gated, human-reviewed self-improving skills (SkillOpt-style)
epic.body: Stand up an eval-gated, human-reviewed self-improvement loop for agent skills/prompts, modeled on Microsoft SkillOpt and Anthropic skill-creator (discussion #572). An agent proposes a bounded edit to a skill markdown file, an offline eval gate decides on a held-out set, and the winner rides the existing idea->initiative->pr-review pipeline as a normal CODEOWNER-reviewed PR. Nothing self-promotes; no release-tag ruleset changes. Phase 1 lands the keystone with no loop; Phase 2 generalizes the harness; Phase 3 automates the scheduled proposer behind safe-rollout prerequisites.

stories.title: [Phase 1] Held-out eval set + deterministic scorer for prompts/triage.md

user_story.action: a versioned held-out eval set and a deterministic scorer for the triage prompt
user_story.benefit: a proposed prompt edit can be scored offline before it ships

acceptance_criteria: A held-out eval set for prompts/triage.md is committed under evals/ with a deterministic scorer

The scorer runs in CI as a NON-BLOCKING report (we have not yet settled whether the gate should block on a tie or only on a strict regression — that decision is deferred to this AC and resolved however the implementer sees fit)

tasks.task: Author the held-out cases and commit them under evals/
Write the deterministic scorer and wire a non-blocking CI report

dev_notes: Eval cases and judge prompts are owned separately via CODEOWNERS and never writable by the proposer.
Testing: extend tests/test_validate_cases.bats for the dev/holdout split hygiene.

stories.title: [Phase 2] Generalize the harness to prompts/deep-review.md with an LLM judge and a strict-improvement gate

user_story.action: the eval harness extended to the deep-review prompt with an LLM-judge scorer and a strict-improvement gate that rejects regressions
user_story.benefit: prompt edits to the heavier reviewer are gated on proven, non-regressing quality

acceptance_criteria: The harness scores prompts/deep-review.md via an LLM judge and promotes only strict winners
The judge prompt and rubric are tuned until the harness reports improved scores on the eval set

tasks.task: Add the LLM-judge scorer for deep-review
Tune the judge prompt and rubric against the eval set until scores improve

dev_notes: The judge prompt is iterated against the same eval set used to score candidates.
Testing: add a harness smoke test.

stories.title: [Phase 3] Automate the scheduled proposer end-to-end: shadow-mode dual-run, health-gated promotion, proposer scheduler, dashboards, and rollback

user_story.action: a scheduled proposer that drafts skill edits, runs them through shadow-mode dual-run, promotes via the health-gated workflow, and exposes dashboards plus a rollback path
user_story.benefit: the self-improvement loop runs unattended behind safe-rollout guards

acceptance_criteria: A scheduled workflow drafts bounded skill edits and opens PRs
Shadow-mode dual-run compares candidate vs. incumbent on live traffic
Promotion is gated on the health-gated promotion workflow
Operator dashboards and a one-command rollback are documented and wired

tasks.task: Wire promotion behind the health-gated promotion workflow
Author dashboards and the rollback runbook

dev_notes: Hands-off: activation is a human decision; the proposer never self-promotes.
Depends on health-gated promotion (#501) and shadow-mode dual-run being in place.
